answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 15 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 860 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The crystal test is the live device, the river test is the locked stake, and the nectar test is the graded history no template can fake.
